issues: Rhinoplasty risks: "4 to 18.8%" complication rate and "under 1%" necrosis are attributed to the necrosis case report, but the supplied evidence shows only its title and keywords. These figures are unsupported and fabricated-looking; remove them or cite verifiable evidence.

Rhinoplasty risks: "about 2 in 100 treated patients underwent revisions" is attributed to the meta-analysis, but the supplied evidence contains no revision rate. The FAQ repeats the revision claim. Unsupported statistic; remove it or source it.
